title: Todd Monken: "Nothing's changed" with QB competition, hope to have answer by end of spring

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken: "Nothing's changed" with QB competition, hope to have answer by end of spring
sources.description: The Browns kicked off the OTA stage of their offseason program this week and the move into more intense on-field work hasn't altered their approach to their quarterback competition.
